T: Do the same thing as last time. Snacks included.
D: Schmidt and Jenko go undercover at college to find who is supplying a new drug.
P: Serve the crab when the crab people gag kicks in.
S: My name is Jeff crab cakes

Golden crab cakes bound with mayonnaise, spring onion and lemon, pan-fried crisp and served with smoky chipotle mayonnaise and lime. Mix 400g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 2 sliced spring onions, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tsp Dijon and 60g panko crumbs. Shape into 12 small cakes and chill 30 minutes. Roll in 60g more panko. Fry in 3 tbsp oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime. Serve the cakes with the mayo and lime wedges.

Crisp baked wings glazed in a sticky honey barbecue sauce with soy and smoked paprika, scattered with sesame and spring onion. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for 3 minutes until sticky. Toss the hot wings in the glaze and return to the oven for 5 minutes. Scatter with 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.
M: spring break, with the captain hot on their heels

Crisp beer-battered flathead in warm tortillas with lime slaw, pickled red onion, chipotle crema and fresh coriander. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tsp chipotle sauce. Fill 12 warm tortillas with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.
W: Dining hall skillet choc chip cookie

One giant choc chip cookie baked in a cast iron pan until gooey in the middle, topped with vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce. Melt 125g butter and beat in 150g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 200g plain flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chocolate chips. Press into a greased 25cm ovenproof frying pan. Bake at 180C for 18 to 20 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the centre. Rest 5 minutes, then top with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and drizzle with chocolate sauce. Serve with 4 spoons.
K: Tequila, fresh lime and frozen mango blended icy smooth with a splash of orange liqueur, poured into salt-rimmed glasses. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 glasses and dip in sea salt flakes. Blend 400g frozen mango, 160ml tequila, 60ml orange liqueur, the juice of 4 limes, 2 tbsp sugar syrup and 2 cups of ice until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels. For an alcohol-free version, swap the tequila and liqueur for 200ml orange juice.
